evidence.reason: Volume is high (three sidebar groups, a 77-item roadmap, 54 blocks) and every desktop docs surface shows a header search field with a visible 'Ctrl K' keyboard shortcut. On mobile the search box is not in the header and not visible in the captured top of the open menu, so mobile reachability could not be confirmed; INTERACTION is a chrome-less block without search.

At 390 px the header shows a hamburger icon with the visible label 'Menu' in a ~44 px bar; tapping opens a full-height drawer with grouped links in ~44 px rows and a clear close (X). INTERACTION has no site navigation on any viewport (standalone Playground block), so its 'mobile-nav-open' capture opened the preset combobox instead.

DETAIL shows each demo first with its code block collapsed behind an 'Expand' control, a Copy Page split button with a dropdown, and a TOC summarising sections; INTERACTION tucks secondary actions behind a '...' overflow button and hides the parameter panel on mobile.

The only captured post-interaction states are a focus ring on the preset select and the preset dropdown opened; no capture shows the response to clicking Enviar, Salvar, the reset button or a copy button, so immediate feedback on the primary actions cannot be judged.

The Playground 'Enviar' triggers a model call (long operation) but no loading state of it was captured. DETAIL documents a spinner + 'Carregando' button pattern, which shows the design has a loading component, but its use on the actual operation is not shown.
Forms exist (Playground prompt textarea, header search, Input demo) but no typing, blur or submit-empty state was captured, so inline validation before submit cannot be observed.

The Playground has an icon-only reset button (↺) beside Enviar that would discard the typed prompt; no capture shows whether it asks for confirmation or offers undo. No other destructive action is visible.

Within the first 900 px the landing gives the product name, a one-line value statement, a copyable install command with package-manager tabs and two CTAs straight into Fundamentos/Componentes, with live component demos immediately below. The mobile first screen (captured scrolled) still shows the install command and both CTAs.

The empty Playground prompt shows the example placeholder 'Escreva um slogan para uma sorveteria', the 'Carregar predefinição…' dropdown lists ready-made example prompts under an 'Exemplos' heading, and 'Enviar' is the visible next step.

Help is inline at the point of use rather than a tour: each DETAIL section opens with a one-line explanation directly above its demo ('primary para a ação principal da tela…', 'loading troca o prefixo pelo indicador…'), the search field shows its 'Ctrl K' shortcut inline, and slider values sit next to their labels. Playground parameter labels (Temperatura, Top P) carry no visible help, but hover on them was not captured.
No multi-step flow exists on any captured surface; the '9 de 77 itens do roteiro publicados' pill is roadmap status, not a user-progress stepper.
No testimonials or quotes appear on ENTRY, DISCOVERY, DETAIL or INTERACTION.

Numbers shown are specific counts rather than vague claims: '9 de 77 itens do roteiro publicados', '54 blocos, 140 layouts e 24 efeitos', '8 presets', '77 itens no roteiro, 9 publicados', each attributed to the Roteiro page or named upstream repositories.
No pricing or signup decision point exists on any surface; the only attribution (built on a named starter, MIT) sits in the footer.
No personal, payment or sensitive data is collected: the inputs are a documentation search, a URL demo field and a demo Playground prompt; there is no signup, email or checkout form.
